name: noop
tagline: Offline WHOOP replacement — no cloud, no account
description: noop is an open-source companion for WHOOP-style wearable tracking that runs entirely offline: no cloud, no account, no data leaving your device. Version 10.0 released this week and made the HN front page on 13 August with 597 stars. It is the privacy-first answer to a wearable ecosystem that has become increasingly subscription and cloud-bound.
highlights: Full offline wearable tracking — no cloud or account
v10.0 released this week, HN front page on 13 August
curatorNote: The wearable space is a walled garden of subscriptions; noop proves the whole tracking loop can run offline. The 10.0 release landing on HN suggests it is hitting maturity.
